evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing and HTTP response handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes incorrect HTTP error status codes on malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests to conform to specification and resolves an internal Assume() failure. In debug builds, the flawed error handling trips an assumption that crashes the node on malformed requests, while release builds return HTTP 400 rather than the expected HTTP 200 OK containing the JSON-RPC error payload.
